newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sept T-bond futures rise one full point.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sept T-bond futures rise one full point.

text.p: U.S. September Treasury bond futures rose to a full-point gain at 115-00 in the fallout from the release of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins text.
September initially cut its gains, then rose through resistance at 114-15/32 to 17/32.
Greenspan's prepared comments for a House banking panel said the Fed may eventually need to change rates, but for now growth was slowing.
Traders said T-bond futures trading was moderate, up from early quiet levels.
In the short end, traders called action very brisk, with December Euros hitting buy-stops from 94.10 to 94.12.
